ex.en: She made a reservation at the restaurant for seven o'clock.
ex.zh: 她在餐厅预订了七点的位子。

words.note: make a reservation 是订位、订房的固定说法，动词是 reserve。

ex.en: Government spending helped revive the economy after the long recession.
ex.zh: 政府支出帮助经济在长期衰退后复苏。

words.note: re-（再）+ vive（生命），指重新恢复活力，可用于经济、传统、记忆。

ex.en: The two leaders held a cordial meeting despite their differences.
ex.zh: 尽管存在分歧，两位领导人仍进行了友好的会晤。

words.note: cordial 侧重真诚热情，多形容欢迎、关系、气氛，比 friendly 更正式。

ex.en: The timid boy stood at the back and said nothing.
ex.zh: 那个羞怯的男孩站在后面，一言不发。

words.note: timid 指因缺乏自信而胆怯，与 bold、confident 相对。

ex.en: He showed great loyalty to the company during the crisis.
ex.zh: 危机期间他对公司表现出极大的忠诚。

words.note: loyal 是形容词，be loyal to sb；loyalty 是名词。

ex.en: The manager dismissed the suggestion without giving any reason.
ex.zh: 经理没有给出任何理由就否定了这个建议。

words.note: dismiss 主要指“不再考虑”，也可指解雇；名词为 dismissal。

ex.en: Doctors are still trying to find the underlying cause of her pain.
ex.zh: 医生仍在努力寻找她疼痛的根本原因。

words.note: underlie 是动词“位于…之下、构成…基础”，underlying 为形容词。

ex.en: The government promised to reform the tax system within two years.
ex.zh: 政府承诺在两年内改革税制。

words.note: re-（重新）+ form（形式），即重新塑造；作名词常指制度改革。

ex.en: Engineers will install the new equipment next Monday.
ex.zh: 工程师们将于下周一安装新设备。

words.note: install 接设备、软件等；名词 installation 拼写时注意双 l。

ex.en: A heated argument ensued after the announcement was made.
ex.zh: 消息公布后，随即爆发了一场激烈的争论。

words.note: ensue 为不及物动词，常与 from 连用，表示“由…引起”。

ex.en: There is little indication that prices will fall this year.
ex.zh: 几乎没有迹象表明今年物价会下降。

words.note: indicate 是动词；indication 常接 that 从句或 of 短语。

ex.en: The bulk of the students passed the examination easily.
ex.zh: 大部分学生轻松通过了考试。

words.note: the bulk of + 名词表示“大部分”；in bulk 指大批量购买或散装。

phr.en: take the bull by the horns

ex.en: Investors stayed confident during the long bull market.
ex.zh: 在漫长的牛市中，投资者一直保持信心。

words.note: bull market（牛市）与 bear market（熊市）相对。

ex.en: She became world champion at the age of nineteen.
ex.zh: 她十九岁时成为世界冠军。

words.note: champion 作名词指冠军，作动词指拥护、支持某项事业。

ex.en: The kitchen floor is covered with blue ceramic tiles.
ex.zh: 厨房地面铺着蓝色的瓷砖。

words.note: ceramic 作形容词指陶瓷的；复数名词 ceramics 指陶瓷器。

ex.en: She gave me a queer look and walked away.
ex.zh: 她奇怪地看了我一眼就走开了。

words.note: queer 指奇怪、反常，近义词为 odd、strange，语域偏旧。

ex.en: He was chosen as the successor to the retiring director.
ex.zh: 他被选为那位即将退休董事的继任者。

words.note: successor 后接介词 to；反义词为 predecessor（前任）。

ex.en: The book offers real enlightenment on how children learn languages.
ex.zh: 这本书对儿童如何学习语言提供了真正的启示。

words.note: enlighten 是动词“启发”；大写 the Enlightenment 指启蒙运动。

ex.en: The hotel provides a free booklet about local attractions.
ex.zh: 酒店提供一本介绍当地景点的免费小册子。

words.note: -let 是表示“小”的后缀，如 booklet 小册子、leaflet 传单。

ex.en: From the top of the hill we enjoyed a magnificent view.
ex.zh: 从山顶上我们欣赏到壮丽的景色。

words.note: magnificent 强调宏伟壮丽，语气远强于 good、great。

ex.en: The injured man staggered to his feet and called for help.
ex.zh: 受伤的男子摇晃着站起来呼救。

words.note: stagger 指摇晃着走；be staggered by 表示“对…大为震惊”。

ex.en: The irony is that the safety expert was hurt in an accident.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，那位安全专家在一次事故中受伤了。

words.note: irony 指言语反讽或事情的讽刺意味，形容词为 ironic。

ex.en: The new rules restrict access to the research laboratory.
ex.zh: 新规定限制了研究实验室的进入。

words.note: restrict 常与 to 连用；名词形式是 restriction。

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the cut and put a bandage on it.
ex.zh: 护士清洗了伤口并贴上绷带。

words.note: bandage 作名词指绷带，作动词指用绷带包扎，可及物。

ex.en: The prevalence of online shopping has changed city life.
ex.zh: 网购的普及改变了城市生活。

words.note: prevalent 是形容词“普遍的”；prevalence 多用于疾病、现象。

ex.en: He wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
ex.zh: 他把地址写在一小片纸上。

words.note: scrap 作名词指碎片、废料，作动词指废弃、取消计划。

ex.en: Doctors have identified a rare syndrome affecting young children.
ex.zh: 医生已确认一种影响幼儿的罕见综合征。

words.note: syndrome 指一组症状构成的综合征，也喻指某种不良现象。

ex.en: The broken car was towed away by a truck.
ex.zh: 那辆坏了的汽车被卡车拖走了。

words.note: tow away 指把违章或故障车辆拖走；in tow 表示“跟随”。

ex.en: It is imperative that we act before the situation gets worse.
ex.zh: 我们必须在情况恶化之前采取行动。

words.note: it is imperative that 从句用虚拟语气 (should + 原形)。

ex.en: Cows were grazing quietly in the green meadow.
ex.zh: 奶牛在绿色的草地上安静地吃草。

words.note: meadow 指长草的开阔地，多用于乡村、牧场语境。
